710360203.text: Thanks for your concern. I'm quite fine now, thanks. I'm sorry for causing you trouble before.

710360206.text: C'mon, Zhiqiong, just stop running around everywhere already, or you'll end up like you did the last time.

710360207.text: Alright, I won't. Thanks to your efforts, The Chasm has become a lot safer. The geological peculiarities here have also, well, stabilized a fair bit.

710360208.text: However, Jinwu and Khedive still need to conduct further analysis on that mysterious crystal's... Uh...

710360209.text: Wavelength, I think Khedive called it? I guess it's just some sort of weird Sumeru jargon. Whatever the case, we need to plant some beacons and get some of that data.

710360210.text: Jinwu finally found the time to put those beacons together, and I need to put them down in a few specific locations to get the data we need.

710360211.text: After a while, we can go and collect them, and Khedive will then sift through the data obtained.

710360212.text: Previously, there were too many hazardous areas for us to do anything but perform data analysis from our campsite...

710360213.text: But now that you've cleared much of the way for us, we can use the beacons to get more accurate data.

710360214.text: *sigh* Well, having something to do is better than having nothing at all on your plate. Ah, right! Do you mind coming with me if you're free?

710360205.text: I'm alright... But I wouldn't say I'm super good. I mean, you did hog all the exploration glory, didn't you?

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the exploration team's camp at The Chasm

710360301.text: Well, thanks for your help! Please, take this as a little token of appreciation.

710360303.text: Well, the various geological anomalies have mostly stopped lately, which means that I've just needed to make some small amendments to my maps.

710360304.text: Thanks to your adventures, our work has become a lot easier, too.

710360305.text: Ah, don't let me keep you any longer. Whether you need some rest or would like to continue your adventures, please, go ahead!

710360306.text: It's going to be a while before we will go and retrieve the beacons. It'll be nice if you could help us out then, too!

710411203.text: Eh? My maps? There's honestly not much to be said about them. Before I joined the Adventurers' Guild, I was the mine cartographer.

710411204.text: Of course, I wasn't just some person sitting behind a desk... In fact, we couldn't be more different.

710411234.text: I was once commissioned by them to map out the terrain of Qiaoying Village... and after all that work, they canceled the construction project just like that, with only a word.

710411205.text: People like them get assistants to do the dirty exploration work and information-gathering for them, and then they start drawing... But those like me? We can't do that.

710411206.text: As... well, half a miner myself, I've long gotten used to passing through the dangerous underground passages. It's just the way the job works.

710411207.text: Also, after that great change, the lower levels of The Chasm have really been truly unstable.

710411208.text: Eh? Unstable? Is that very dangerous?

710411209.text: You bet it is. The terrain here is slowly but constantly changing. A path today might be a rock wall next month. It's almost as if... How should I say this...

710411210.text: It's almost as if The Chasm itself is changing shape as it likes.

710411211.text: Uh... things can't be that spooky, right?

710411213.text: Haha, what? My "life"? You don't have to be so polite. I'm just a newbie. I've barely started my journey, unlike you.

710411214.text: I have completed some commissions from the Guild, of course, but I'm not that experienced yet, so I haven't done much solo exploration. I don't think I've left any tales of my deeds behind either...

710411215.text: So I've been thinking that The Chasm might be just the place for me to make my mark for future generations to remember me by.

710411216.text: The Chasm might be, to quote the great adventurer Alice, my "Rubicon"!

710411224.text: Him? I don't trust him. We've had to deal with the Treasure Hoarders above the mines for who-knows how long. They're up to no good. I know it!

710411225.text: Don't you trust a word that he says. Turning over a new leaf... Washing his hands of the situation...

710411226.text: While they say such pretty words, they'll be reaching their filthy hands into your back pocket.

710411227.text: Even Rex Lapis would have trouble protecting your wallet from them then!

710411228.text: I'm not prejudiced or anything... I'm just telling you to be wary. The Treasure Hoarders are never to be trusted.

710411229.text: That does sound like prejudice to me, though.

710411230.text: ...Maybe it is. You've probably seen a great many more things than I have, so I guess you might be more generous to them. But as for me, I'll always keep an eye at the back of my head, just for them.

710411231.text: And I'll keep doing that until this guy can prove that he's got nothing more to do with those despicable "former" companions of his.
